notes: Minimal round-trip: system.init (emits ONE authoritative empty snapshot per ephemeral live set — background_tasks_update, then workflow_progress_update — so a row from a pre-rebuild SDK process cannot linger when no result boundary ever arrives) + user echo (INTENTIONALLY NOT re-emitted — the renderer shows the user bubble optimistically and the engine seeds it via persistUserPrompt; re-emitting the stream echo duplicated the bubble and rendered subagent user-turns as the real user) + thinking + answer + result. Tests the happy path for every content-block variant Claude emits in --output-format stream-json.
